question: The symbol of Indian Rupee, was conceptualized and designed by whom?
solution:
The correct answer is__** D Udaya Kumar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• D. Udaya Kumar, a talented designer, won an open competition organized by the Government of India to design the Indian Rupee symbol.
 
• His winning design, a blend of the Devanagari letter "Ra" and the Roman capital letter "R," was officially adopted in 2010.
 
• The symbol effectively represents the Indian currency while also incorporating elements of the Indian flag and a sense of equality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gurbaksh Singh Dhillon was a prominent figure in the Indian National Army (INA).
 
 
• He commanded the Nehru Brigade and actively participated in military operations against the British.
 
• His involvement led to his arrest and subsequent trial for waging war against the British Indian government.
 
 
 
• Prem Kumar Sehgal was another key leader in the INA. As a Colonel, he played a crucial role in the INA's military campaigns.
 
 
• He was captured by the British and charged with waging war against the British Indian government, facing trial alongside other INA leaders.
 
 
 
• Shah Nawaz Khan was a highly respected Major General in the INA.
 
 
• He led significant military operations against the British and was a charismatic figure among the INA soldiers.
 
• Like Dhillon and Sehgal, he was arrested and charged with waging war against the British Indian government.
